deuce-deuce.bio: Deuce-Deuce (styled deuce-DEUCE) is a hip-hop duo from Ottawa, Ontario, consisting of Harvey Stripes and Twellve. Their debut street release, Paperboys - The EP, earned them HipHopCanada's featured artist of the month recognition in December 2002. Its first single, "Paperboys," received airplay on university and college radio. In 2006, the duo released Ballerz Presents: The Best of deuce DEUCE, a greatest-hits mixtape hosted by Ottawa DJ Dice. Harvey Stripes later moved to Toronto and founded D&D Music Group, which released the duo's Double or Nothing mixtape, hosted by DJ Absolut, in August 2008. Northern Dial's library includes "Paperboys" and "Where Do We Go" from the EP, added November 21, 2026.
